intent_contract.text: 절벽 위에 서서 떠오르는 해를 보며 만족스럽게 풍경을 내려다보는 트레저헌터의 뒷모습

A triumphant but quiet cinematic adventure portrait in which the adult treasure hunter from the supplied appearance reference pauses at a cliff edge and takes satisfied pleasure in the sunrise landscape below.

A wide cinematic adventure photograph of the same clearly adult woman suggested by the supplied portrait, recognizable from behind by her long silver-ash twin ponytails, now dressed as a seasoned treasure hunter in a weathered leather field jacket, utility belt, sturdy trousers, boots, and a compact explorer's pack. She stands at the edge of a high rugged cliff, viewed fully from behind, quietly surveying a vast valley at sunrise. The rising sun breaks over distant mountains, turning mist-filled rivers, forest, and ancient ruins below into layers of amber and pale gold. Her shoulders are relaxed, chin slightly lifted, and stance calm and grounded, expressing satisfied pride after a difficult journey. Wind lifts her ponytails and jacket hem. Emphasize the immense landscape, solitary victorious silhouette, realistic natural light, tactile worn gear, and photographic detail.

render_gates.description: The cup is near upright rather than visibly tipping or falling.
The full cup base visibly contacts a broad opaque-clothed support area with a shallow contact shadow or compression.
The cup centerline falls inside the visible support area, so the load appears stable.
Both hands are visibly separated from the cup and do not secretly hold or brace it.
No straw bite, chin contact, transparent shelf, cropped hand, or concealed prop supplies the missing support.
